identity.title: Community Pharmacy
identity.subtitle: Study Decks
identity.credit_policy: No author name on the decks, as the user asked. The decks are built from the course's own sources (sections, quizzes and labs) for East Port Said National University; the sources are transcribed into intake/ and every slide is checked against them.
identity.rework_authorised_note: The user supplied the course sources of Port Said University and East Port Said National University and asked for study decks for East Port Said National University.

domain.primary: Community pharmacy practice: responding to symptoms and OTC treatment
subfields: respiratory conditions: sore throat, tonsillitis, common cold, influenza, cough, rhinitis
pharmacist counselling, referral and patient cases

figures.notes: Native PowerPoint diagrams drawn by build_study; pictures taken from the course sources where they exist.

audience.prior_knowledge: Pharmacology and microbiology of the earlier years.

goal.notes: Decks-only project: no book is written. Study decks (build_study.py, source mode) are built topic by topic from the transcribed course sources; content fixed to the sources, few words per slide, diagrams and the sources' pictures, MCQs from the course quizzes with an answer key at the end.

language.terminology: Drug names, doses and abbreviations (QDS, TDS, BD, OD) exactly as in the sources.

size.restructuring_note: About 12 chapters: the six marketing lectures and three economics lectures are reorganised and split where a topic needs its own chapter; the order of the source syllabus is kept.

mcq.format: MCQs taken from the course quizzes, two per slide, answer key with reasons at the end of the deck.

references.style_note: APA 7 author-date citations in the text; each chapter lists what it cites, and one consolidated reference list closes the book. At least 60% of sources date from 2016 or later; classic sources are kept where they are the origin of a concept.

must_keep: The sources' wording, drug names, doses, age limits and durations
must_not_change: No fact, dose or age limit that is not in the sources
Contradictions in the sources are shown as 'to be confirmed', never resolved by guessing
Section 2 page 11 lists Benzydamine spray under >12 years and again as Spray/lozenge >6 yrs: to be confirmed with the course doctor (user, 2026-10-01).

domain_pillars.name: Pharmacotherapy and dose accuracy against the sources

A.note: Project name 'community pharmacy'; no author name on the decks (user's choice).

C.note: For East Port Said National University; the sources are shared with Port Said University.

E.note: Light deck project chosen by the user; decks built with the study-deck skill; first deck: tonsillitis, with the sore-throat treatments and the quiz and lab cases; the sources' pictures used.
